domain_rationale: Correctness depends on cell-culture practice: population doublings on viable counts, which suspension a seed's viability belongs to, cumulative PDL and passage number along a lineage through freeze and thaw, in-vitro age after a culture crash, and cell-bank vial inventory. The deliverable is Python, but software engineering does not decide any graded value; the cell-bank SOP does.
evidence: instruction.md: the requested outcome is the lineage report (passage, doublings, PDL, limit flag per culture; vials left and PDL per bank) of a cell line's passage log, judged against SOP CB-3

environment/app/docs/cell-bank-sop.md: rules 2.3-2.4 (viable counts and the seed's viability), 3.1 (doublings), 4.1-4.3 (passage and PDL along the lineage, thaw is not a passage), 5.1-5.2 (age and limit flags), 6.1-6.2 (bank stock and PDL)
planned verifier: compares the complete report of hand-built and seeded passage logs with expectations sealed from solution/model.py, written from the SOP
